# Melo Creative

> Brand agency for health, tech and law businesses. Melo translates technical authority into brand authority: branding, visual identity, high-end websites and film production, delivered end-to-end in-house.

Melo Creative is a creative agency based in São Paulo, Brazil, operating since 2020. It has delivered 3,000+ projects, accelerated 50+ brands, and works 100% in-house from strategy to final render. Its client base is concentrated in healthtech, health data, scientific platforms, renewable energy, and a boutique health-law firm — businesses whose credibility comes from technical or professional authority and that need a brand that communicates it clearly.

## Services

- Strategy: positioning and market direction for the brand.
- Brand: visual and verbal identity systems.
- Websites & Systems: high-end websites, platforms and proprietary tools.
- Film production: full audiovisual production, from script to final frame.

## Site

- [Homepage (Portuguese, default)](https://www.melocreative.com.br/): agency overview, services, process and results.
- [Homepage (English)](https://www.melocreative.com.br/en/): English version of the site.
- [Case studies](https://www.melocreative.com.br/cases): all published projects, filterable by service type.
- [KHS Advocacia](https://www.melocreative.com.br/khs): brand identity and web platform for a boutique law firm specialized in health law.
- [brain4care](https://www.melocreative.com.br/brain4care): design, motion graphics and video production for a healthtech company.
- [4Research](https://www.melocreative.com.br/4research): brand repositioning and identity for a health data and technology company.
- [REDCap Brasil](https://www.melocreative.com.br/redcap): visual identity and graphic system for a scientific data platform.
- [Ekoenergy](https://www.melocreative.com.br/ekoenergy): brand strategy and digital identity for a renewable energy company.
- [Aromatici](https://www.melocreative.com.br/aromatici): rebrand and e-commerce for a science-based dermocosmetics brand.
